The thermal relay in the
spindle motor was tripped due
to one of the following
reasons.
(A)Motor is overloaded or
locked.
(B)Machining condition has
exceeded motor's capacity.
(C)The spindle motor fan
stopped.

(A)Use your hands to turn the spindle
to make sure that it is not heavy or
sluggish.
(B)Follow the procedure below.
1. Revise the machining conditions
and operating pattern.
2. Wait 30 minutes without turning
OFF the power before resuming
operation.
3. If the alarm triggers again, contact
the nearest BROTHER approved
service dealer and report the alarm
conditions.
(C)The spindle motor fan is not
rotating.
Follow one of the procedures below.
(a)Make sure that the breaker FC2 is
ON. If it is OFF, remove the cause of
the short-circuit or overload on the
spindle motor fan, and then turn ON
the breaker FC2.
(b)Clean the oil adhering to the
spindle motor fan.
(c)Check the connection for the
XSPKF connector on the IO PCB.

The APC pallet clamp
operation did not complete
properly within the prescribed
time period.
Potential causes are noted
below:
(A) The pallet is not positioned
on.
(B) The pallet did not clamp.
(C) There is an air leak on the
pallet unclamp valve.
(D) The connector and/or
wiring for the pallet unclamp
valve and seating sensor is
faulty.
(E) The seating sensor error
caused a stop.
(F) The pallet unclamp valve is
defective.
(G) The pallet clamp air blow
valve is defective.
(H) The seating sensor is
defective.
(I) IO PCB is faulty.
(J) The seating monitoring SW
is defective.

1. Position the pallet correctly on the
machine.
2. Make sure that the seating
monitoring SW is enabled. If the
alarm triggers when disabled, replace
the monitoring seating SW.
If the alarm still triggers even after
checking, follow one of the
procedures below to correct any
problems.
(A) Position the pallet on the
machine.
(B) Remove any foreign objects such
as chips or shavings.
(C) Check the air piping for the
unclamp valve.
(D) Replace the unclamp valve or
seating sensor wiring.
(E) Make sure that there is no error
on the seating sensor. Make sure that
the air setting is correct.
(F) Replace the unclamp valve.
(G) Replace the air blow valve.
(H) Replace the seating sensor.
(I) Replace the IO PCB.
(J) Replace the seating monitoring
SW.

taper.

the servo error when a servo error is

service dealer. To continue to use the
machine, set the user parameter

over key detection function> to <0:
